name: When should I replace my bathroom faucet?

mainEntity.name: When should I replace my bathroom faucet?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider replacing your bathroom faucet if it's leaking consistently, shows significant corrosion, has difficulty turning on or off, or if you notice a decrease in water pressure that isn't due to other plumbing issues. Often, updating a faucet can also improve the aesthetic of your bathroom, making it a good time for replacement during a renovation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replace your bathroom faucet if it's leaking, corroded, difficult to operate, or has low water pressure.
